title: Perfect outing!
text: What a perfect b way to get an overview of the city.  Simo did a great job.  Thanks so much!!
author: landwpublic

title: This was a fantastic...
text: This was a fantastic experience!!!! We saw so much in 3 hours and our guide Temo(sorry spelling) was knowledgeable and very personable. He was great with our safety/took pictures for us and found me a washroom.  Everything we asked he answered. I would recommend him to anyone!!
author: Janice_W

title: GREAT TOUR
text: Because it is off season there was just me and my daughter for the tour. But it was perfect. Our guide explained everything, told us interesting facts about Barcelona and adjusted the tour just as we wanted. We didn't have much time in Barcelona so we are glad we could see all the main points in just under 2 hours.
author: annaeZ6143MF

title: This was a good choice.
text: First time scooters and had a great time. Much more enjoyable than the bus tour we took the previous day! Not everyone got on with the scooter but this was not a problem. No issue with changing to e-Bikes so we all went and enjoyed together, scooter & e-Bike alike. Super helpful staff.
author: Heath29_20

title: Outstanding
text:
This is one of the best tours I did in Spain. It was so much fun. Being on a scooter we were able to cover a lot of area without being exhausted. 
I researched the scooter tours available and this was definitely the best as we visited great landmarks.
The scooter itself was in great condition and seemed quite powerful. 
I would do it again and highly recommend this tour.
author: freedomlover63

title: Barcelona tour
text: Semo is the best tour guide in the city of Barcelona. He is really helpful and made my experience really fun. I would highly recommend you go with him.
author: 568kwameo

title: Perfect way to see a lot in a little amount of time
text: We had a blast on our scooters just my daughter and I since the other party cancelled! Our tour guide was great and explained all the things we were seeing! Great way to see a lot in a little amount of time!
author: Angela_S

title: Great experience! Very...
text: Great experience! Very informative guide. We chose between an electric bike or scooter. We zipped through the city and the guide took so many great pictures and videos for us.
author: Fyoure_F

title: Self guide scooter ride
text: So friendly and helpful. We had a great time! Good price and nice scooters. Definitely recommend. The location made it a good launching spot to see the beach, park, and gothic quarter
author: debramatt4

title: Amazing service
text:
Friendly helpful staff. Very informative. 
Was such fun to travel Barcelona on scooter via park and beach. Really recommend
author: 364jemman
